recipes.name: Agua de Jamaica Granita
ingredients: 1/2 to 3/4 cup granulated sugar, or to taste
1 stick cinnamon, orange peel, or a few cloves, optional
instructions: In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil. - 4 cups water

Add dried sorrel leaves (and optional aromatics if you’re feeling fancy). Let simmer for 10 minutes, then strain out solids. - 1 cup dried sorrel leaves - 1 stick cinnamon orange peel, or a few cloves, optional
Stir in the sugar while it’s hot, adjusting to your sweetness preference. - ½ to 3/4 cup granulated sugar or to taste
Cool to room temp before freezing. - For the Granita
Place the metal rimmed baking sheet in the freezer.
Pour the tea into the baking sheet, and freeze for 2-3 hours, scraping every 30 minutes. - For the Granita
After 30 minutes, scrape it up with a fork. You’ll see vibrant purple crystals start to form. - For the Granita
Repeat scraping every 30 minutes or so, until it’s light, fluffy, and fully granita-fied - For the Granita
Combine heavy cream and sweet condensed milk in a mixing bowl and whisk vigorously until soft peaks form. - ½ cup heavy cream - 1 tbsp sweetened condensed milk

Spoon the finished granita into a chilled cup or coupe and top with a dollop of whipped cream, a drizzle of condensed milk, and a sprinkle of lime zest. - Whipped Cream - sweetened condensed milk - lime zested - For the Granita
